name: batch-3-fire-core
note: REA_18 §5 batch 3, the Fire core: the five ELEMENT_PAIR cells a Fire core reads (火_土 the Expression, 火_金 the Action, 火_水 the Order, 火_木 the Mind, 火_火 the Body) with both poles, both turns, both definitions, both advices, the verdict, the base and the carry parts for every state the cell renders (the station's carry keys; 火_火 has no wide, missing or spared and carries unrooted), and the ten ELEMENT_GOD cells whose god sits on a Fire core (the ELEMENT_GOD key is <energy>_<god>: the Body pair on Fire, 火_比肩 and 火_劫财; the Expression pair on Earth, 土_食神 and 土_伤官; the Action pair on Metal, 金_偏财 and 金_正财; the Order pair on Water, 水_七杀 and 水_正官; the Mind pair on Wood, 木_偏印 and 木_正印), both poles, all three rows, all three angles, candidates: 2 on each drive passage. Built by handoff.mjs --scope on prompt v0.7.5 (2026-10-15), after batch 2; the dispatch prompt now names the two gate laws the batch 2 writers' checkers missed (the four-gram against value_b, the zone on the chip word) and the hinge forms. The yin sibling's overrides (read by 丁) are not in this batch. No chart: no percentage, no band, no state of one chart in any value.
